blocks_element.text: 1. Everist Concentrates are a Hybrid of Haircare and Skincare

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Your hair health starts with your scal…
blocks_element.text: Your hair health starts with your scalp. Everist concentrates are a first-of-their-kind product that combines the cleansers and actives of traditional hair care in a base of moisturizer. Where traditional haircare is designed for short-term results, Everist's patent-pending concentrates are designed for overall hair, skin and scalp health (and the immediate results will surprise you!).

blocks_element.repere: Grand titre · 2. Traditional Haircare is Mostly Wate…
Paragraphe · Most shampoos, conditioners and body w…
blocks_element.text: Most shampoos, conditioners and body washes are more than 70% water, made from petrochemicals and packed in single-use plastic. Everist is different. By removing the water and using moisturizer as a base instead, they've created cutting edge concentrates that are ultra clean, scalp soothing and leave hair and skin with immediate visible results.

blocks_element.repere: Grand titre · 3. Healthy Scalp = Healthy Hair

blocks_element.text: With more than 30% glycerin (nature's most powerful moisturizer) and 20% aloe vera (to slow scalp aging and soothe inflammation), Everist concentrates are proven to provide longer-lasting scalp hydration vs. traditional water-based shampoo and conditioner and be less disruptive to the scalp microbiome.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In addition to the patent-pending mois…
blocks_element.text: In addition to the patent-pending moisturizer base, Everist concentrates contain an all-natural bond-building complex (a natural alternative to Olaplex) to help repair hair damage with every wash. Everist concentrates are also plant-based, vegan, cruelty-free and color-safe, as well as being free-from sulfates, silicones, dyes and synthetic fragrances.
